note: Accepted wrap and WholeUnwrap transactions from one retained fractional lifecycle on solana-test-validator. Each binding was authored after inspecting the finalized native transaction packet, its resolved inner instructions, runtime invoke logs, and exact account poststate.

bindings.label: wrap
bindings.note: Accepted DCFREQ02 Wrap CPI: seven native claims became 70 Token-2022 shard atoms. The finalized packet contains one exact Claims CPI matching the request that the caller forwarded.

bindings.label: whole-unwrap-actor-remainder
bindings.note: Accepted DCFREQ02 WholeUnwrap CPI after 40 shards moved to an independent sleeper: 30 actor shards burned, three native claims unlocked, and 40 shards plus four reserve claims remained.

bindings.label: token-2022-transfer-to-sleeper
bindings.note: Accepted Token-2022 TransferChecked between the two Claims actions. It is retained because its poststate makes the sleeper liability real, and it claims no first-party protocol route.
